user_query: trass gmail with term shipbob last 3 days

intent.goal: find gmail messages related to shipbob

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.sender_email,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.database_name LIKE '%gmail%'
AND (
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%shipbob%' 
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(g.sender_email) LIKE '%shipbob%'
)
AND (
    u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-3 days')
    OR g.email_date >= datetime('now', '-3 days')
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;

The labels are critical for our logistics chain—without them, we can't properly mark and transfer our inventory to temporary storage. Our Plan Generate WRO and apply pallet labels at FF facility Transfer pallets to temporary UK storage warehouse Once VAT/EORI numbers are received (expected by end of October), coordinate delivery to ShipBob Timeline This is time-sensitive. Our freight forwarder is waiting on these labels to complete the transfer, and storage costs are accumulating daily. Can you please grant us access to create WROs for the UK FC today ?
